mutation.subject: the reference's own scene graph, damaged by declared reference-only controls

subjects.note: Both sides of every comparison are the reference. The undamaged capture stands in for the reference and the damaged capture for a candidate, so the metrics are the acceptance metrics unchanged.

control.note: Every placement turned on its own footprint. Rotation is what world-normal evidence is for: the silhouette of a squarish mass barely moves while every wall faces somewhere else. It applies to every root rather than to the buildings alone so that it differs from the mild yaw in magnitude and in nothing else, which is what a bracket is.
